A tidier format bar.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.6.2-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in the app.

**Mac (test build):** accept the update prompt, or take `Deviload-2.6.2-macos-test.zip`, move it to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once.

**Linux (x86_64):** `Deviload-2.6.2-amd64.deb` or `Deviload-2.6.2-x86_64.AppImage`; the AppImage updates itself.

What's new

- The format bar is laid out in two clean lines: download types with the settings button, then quality, file type and the hint under them
- On narrow windows the controls flow one after another instead of scattering to the right
- The file type choice is hidden for audio downloads, where it does not apply
- Buttons on queue cards no longer run past the window edge when the window is 760 to 900 pixels wide

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.6.1...v2.6.2
